description: Require accounts to verify that they are not a robot before accessing your server

content.name: enabled
content.description: If checked, verification on your server will be enabled

content.name: verification-needed-role
content.humanName: Role for users with pending verification
content.description: Role, which members should be given before they verify themselves

content.name: verification-passed-role
content.humanName: Role for users that passed verification
content.description: Role, which members should be given after they got verified successfully

content.name: verification-log
content.description: Channel where all verification-actions should get logged

content.name: type
content.description: How should new members verify themselves on your server?

content.displayName: Image Captcha: distorted image, solved in-channel
Image Captcha (DM): legacy, sent via direct message
Word challenge: retype a displayed word
Math challenge: solve an arithmetic problem
Manual: a moderator approves each new member
Button click: one click, no challenge

content.name: captchaLevel
content.description: Difficulty of the verification challenge. Applies to Image Captcha, Image Captcha (DM), Word and Math. Not used for Manual or Button.

content.displayName: Hard: longer words / larger numbers & multiplication

content.name: actionOnFail
content.description: What should happen if someone fails the verification?

content.name: verification-channel
content.description: Channel where users can verify themselves by clicking the Verify Me button. For the legacy DM type, this serves as a fallback channel for users with DMs disabled.

content.name: maxRetries
content.description: How many attempts a user gets before the failure action is applied. Applies to Image Captcha, Image Captcha (DM), Word and Math types.

content.name: retryCooldown
content.description: How long a user must wait between verification attempts (e.g. 5m, 10m, 1h).

content.name: actionOnFailDuration
content.description: Duration for mute or quarantine punishment when a user exhausts all verification attempts (e.g. 1h, 1d). Only applies when action on fail is mute or quarantine.

content.name: cooldown-message
content.description: Shown when a user needs to wait before verifying again.

params.name: t
params.description: Discord timestamp showing when the user can try again

content.name: captcha-message
content.default: Welcome! Please verify that you are a human. You have two minutes to complete this.
content.description: This message gets sent to users who need to complete a captcha

content.name: manual-verification-message
content.default: Welcome! A human will be verifying your account shortly. I will update you if I have any news.
content.description: This message gets sent to users who need to get verified manually.

content.name: captcha-failed-message
content.default: It seems like you failed the verification. This is bad, I will have to take moderative actions against you - sorry fellow bot.
content.description: This message gets sent when a user fails the verification

content.name: captcha-succeeded-message
content.default: Thanks! We have verified that you are indeed not a bot, so I granted you access to the whole server! Have fun <3
content.description: This message gets sent to users when they complete the verification

content.name: verify-channel-first-message
content.default: Welcome! Please verify yourself by clicking the button below. This step is required to access this server.
content.description: This message is the introduction message in the verify-channel.
